description_good_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/README.md -- the opening lines say what the software does.
interact_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/README.md and https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md -- how to get it, file issues and contribute.
contribution_requirements_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md -- Conventional Commits, sign-off, signed commits and the repository's full check are required.
floss_license_justification: The MIT license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).
floss_license_osi_justification: The MIT license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).
documentation_interface_justification: README.md#measure-from-the-command-line documents the flags and output of scripts/measure.mjs and evals/p4.mjs. (https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/README.md)
discussion_justification: GitHub Issues: searchable, addressable by URL, open to anyone, no proprietary client required.
english_justification: All docs are in English; issues and PRs in English are expected and supported.
maintained_justification: Actively maintained; see the commit history.
repo_track_justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git tracks the changes, who made them, and when.
repo_interim_justification: Commits between releases are visible in git history.
repo_distributed_justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git is distributed.
version_unique_justification: Every release has a unique version, 1.0.0 onwards, set in .claude-plugin/plugin.json and tagged m3l-output-governor--vX.Y.Z. Every commit also has a unique SHA.
version_semver_justification: Releases use Semantic Versioning. The contract that a major, minor or patch bump refers to is defined under Versioning policy in README.md.
version_tags_justification: Each release is a signed git tag named m3l-output-governor--vX.Y.Z, and the org tags ruleset stops a tag being moved or deleted.
release_notes_justification: Each release has a GitHub release page whose notes are the matching CHANGELOG.md section.
release_notes_vulns_justification: No CVE has been assigned against this project. SECURITY.md's process commits to a published advisory if one is.
report_process_justification: Bug reports go through GitHub Issues: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/issues (see also https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
report_responses_justification: No bug report from outside the organization has been opened to date, so none is unanswered. SECURITY.md commits to acknowledging a vulnerability report within 7 days.
enhancement_responses_justification: Enhancement requests are triaged the same way as bug reports.
report_archive_justification: GitHub Issues is a public, searchable archive of every report and response: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/issues
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/SECURITY.md commits to acknowledgment within 7 days, under the criterion's 14-day bar.
build_justification: Nothing to build: the repository is used as committed source files.
test_invocation_justification: The standard command for this ecosystem is documented in README.md#working-on-this-repo.
test_most_justification: No statement-coverage measurement or gate is configured. This criterion is only suggested.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/.github/workflows/verify.yml runs the suite on every push and PR.
test_policy_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-requests -- new behaviour needs tests and a fix needs a regression test.
tests_are_added_justification: Recent commits (the eval fixture fix, the measure changes) add tests alongside the behaviour they cover.
tests_documented_added_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-requests and the pull request template both state the policy.
warnings_justification: CodeQL runs on every push and PR, and CI runs actionlint and zizmor on the workflows. There is no TypeScript or separate JavaScript linter.
warnings_fixed_justification: Findings from these tools fail the required `verify` or CodeQL check, so none is merged unfixed.
warnings_strict_justification: Not applicable: no compiler or linter flag to make strict; CodeQL, actionlint and zizmor fail the build on a finding.
know_secure_design_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/SECURITY.md states the scope, secrets handling and accepted risks; the maintainers also keep m3l-groundwork's docs/assurance-case.md (https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md), which maps the Saltzer and Schroeder principles.
know_common_errors_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-groundwork/blob/main/docs/assurance-case.md's CWE Top 25 table, kept by the same maintainers, names the vulnerability types and the mitigation for each.
crypto_password_storage_justification: The project stores no passwords for authenticating users.
delivery_mitm_justification: Distributed only through GitHub over HTTPS.
delivery_unsigned_justification: No hash is fetched over plain HTTP and used without a signature check.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/SECURITY.md commits to fixing a confirmed medium-or-higher vulnerability within 60 days; none is open.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: GitHub secret scanning and push protection are enabled, and .github/workflows/gitleaks.yml runs a second scan on every push and PR.
static_analysis_justification: GitHub CodeQL (default setup) analyzes every push and PR, more often than each release.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL's default query suite covers common vulnerability classes (CWE-mapped).
static_analysis_fixed_justification: CodeQL is a required check on `main`, so a confirmed finding is fixed before merge.
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL runs on every push and PR, not just daily.
dynamic_analysis_justification: No dynamic analysis tool is run. This criterion is only suggested.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: No memory-unsafe code: JavaScript or TypeScript on a managed runtime.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: No dynamic analysis tool is run, so there is nothing to run with assertions enabled. This criterion is only suggested.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No dynamic analysis tool is run.
osps_ac_01_01_justification: The monte3l organization requires two-factor authentication for every member.
osps_ac_02_01_justification: The organization's default repository permission is read; write access is granted by hand.
osps_ac_03_01_justification: The `main` ruleset requires a pull request with a code-owner approval and the required checks, with an empty bypass list. Direct pushes are rejected.
osps_ac_03_02_justification: The `main` ruleset blocks deletion of the branch, with an empty bypass list.
osps_br_01_01_justification: No workflow interpolates event metadata into a script: values reach `run:` steps through `env:`. zizmor, which flags template injection, runs in CI and reports no findings.
osps_br_01_03_justification: No workflow uses `pull_request_target` or `workflow_run`. Pull-request workflows hold read-only tokens and no secrets, except the org Gitleaks license, which the Gitleaks job needs.
osps_br_03_01_justification: Every official project URL (the repository, the issue tracker and the security advisory form) is served over HTTPS by GitHub.
osps_br_03_02_justification: The only distribution channel is GitHub, over HTTPS.
osps_br_07_01_justification: GitHub secret scanning and push protection are on, and .github/workflows/gitleaks.yml scans every push and PR. Both are required checks.
osps_do_01_01_justification: The README Quickstart, How it works and the measure.mjs and p4.mjs flag tables are the user guide for the plugin and its skill.
osps_do_02_01_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md, under Reporting a bug, links to the issue form and says what a report must contain. SECURITY.md covers vulnerabilities.
osps_gv_02_01_justification: GitHub Issues is open for discussion of changes and usage problems: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/issues
osps_gv_03_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md explains the contribution process, including that pull requests are limited to collaborators.
osps_le_02_01_justification: MIT, which meets the OSI Open Source Definition.
osps_le_02_02_justification: MIT, which meets the OSI Open Source Definition, and every release is a tag of this repository.
osps_le_03_02_justification: LICENSE sits at the repository root, so it is inside every release tag and every installed copy of the plugin.
osps_qa_01_02_justification: git history on GitHub records every change, its author and its date.
osps_qa_02_01_justification: The only package-managed dependencies are the CI tools in `.github/ci-tools/`, pinned by `package-lock.json`; every GitHub Action is pinned by commit SHA.
osps_qa_04_01_justification: The project is a single repository.
osps_qa_05_01_justification: The repository holds no generated executable artifacts.
osps_qa_05_02_justification: The repository holds no binary artifacts.
osps_vm_02_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-output-governor/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability gives the private advisory form and the 7-day acknowledgment target.
